outcome: Apgar score lower than 7 in the first minute
cohort: The study included all births from women aged 15-45 years in Lleida, Spain, between 2012 and 2018, totaling 17,177 pregnant women.
finding: Different types of maternal hypertension present varying risks for both the mother and fetus, with preeclampsia being predominantly associated with most complications.
mod_finding: An increased risk of cesarean section was observed in patients with preeclampsia.
